body.condition: \(d_{ej}>0\) is known for every \(e\in\mathcal E\) and \(j\in V\), and \(d_{0j}=1\) for every \(j\in V\).

novel.justification: A calibrated experiment can record each innovation channel's variance multiplier relative to its own reference value. Absolute innovation scales and the units of observed variables need not be shared across sites.
